'''Bonekrusher Raider''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A Landbreaker armed with basic melee weapons. These "common rabble" of LB clans tend to be poorly equipped and usually appear in groups.}}

==Overview==
One of the basic melee Bonekrushers, Bonekrusher Raiders are more of a fodder enemy; Their only attack is an upward swing or a downward swing with their sword, which deals Physical damage.
